function.name: PUT_PIXEL
function.abstract: It changes the value of a pixel of the background of screen

description.p: This function allows to change the colour of a pixel determined of the background of screen. The coordinates increase towards down and right, and the point (0, 0) represents the top left corner of screen.

In the case of the graph mode of 256 colours (8 bits), the value of colour must be a number of 0 to 255. In oppositive case (16 bits), the value is a codification of the components of the colour that changes in function of the video card and the graph mode. It is normal to use the function to obtain the codification of a concrete colour, or to use a colour obtanied by a function like . The background of screen does not accept transparent pixels.
This function is equivalent to MAP_PUT_PIXEL (0, 0, x, y, colour).

function.note: It is possible to use a background of 8 bits in a game that works in mode of 16 bits. Normally, Fenix detects when it happens. For example, a game that uses with a map of 8 bits makes that it is created in background of screen of 8 bits. However, once is used a function like with a graph of 16 bits, the background is created or converted to 16 bits and it can not be changed. It is important to know that because sometimes GET_PIXEL can need a value of 0 to 255 unsuspectedly, although it is working in 16 bits. If you want to be secure which is the depth of colour of the background, you have to use the function with the map (0, 0) and the parameter G_DEPTH.
